scope: Korean course unique indices 500..999, Romanian and Finnish authoring; 1000 records
courseSteps: K1..K10 are course stages, not official proficiency grades 1..6.

contextPolicy.existingPeopleGender: unspecified unless explicit in the same source; names and occupations are not evidence
contextPolicy.number: source-preserved; plural/singular grammar not used to invent omitted participants
contextPolicy.referents: Korean examples and reported-speech embedded subjects take precedence over abbreviated English glosses
contextPolicy.romanianGrammaticalGender: Generic elev/prieten/medic grammatical masculine does not set an existing character’s semantic gender; persoană is grammatically feminine without asserting female identity.
contextPolicy.explicitGender: Grandmother/father/mother lexical meanings and 999 woman-speaker older brother explicitly supplied by source

issues.reason: Source explanation falsely equates an entire counting sequence with the missing number alone. Canonical fill_blank records k-k3-numbers-5/native10-5/sino-5 establish accepted 둘/여덟/삼. Native translations explicitly attribute two/eight/three to the missing word within the preserved full sequence, avoiding the false whole-sequence equivalence. Shared source was not changed.
Persoana mai mică dintre frați preserves unknown sibling gender without listing male/female versions; native fluency review recommended.
Older brother is explicitly said by a woman in this vocabulary definition. Gender is from the same source, not inferred from a name.

limits: AI authoring and surface checks only; no native-speaker, teacher or phonetics-expert approval.
No claim of target-language automatic answer-grading support.
